violation_reason: Transaction reported more than 45 days after the close of the calendar quarter

match_name: Rule 2 — Fixed-Width Records and NAIC Company Code
violation_sql:
j.naic_code IS NULL
OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(j.naic_code), '^[0-9]{5}$')
violation_reason: NAIC company code must be exactly 5 digits

violation_sql:
j.parish_fips IS NULL
OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(j.parish_fips), '^[0-9]{3}$')
violation_reason: Parish code must be the 3-digit FIPS code of the insured dwelling's parish

violation_sql:
j.record_type = 'P'
AND (j.written_premium IS NULL
     OR j.written_premium <> ROUND(j.written_premium))
violation_reason: Written premium must be reported in whole dollars

match_name: Rule 5 — Amount of Insurance Reporting for Coverage A
violation_sql:
j.record_type = 'P'
AND (j.aoi_thousands IS NULL OR j.aoi_thousands <= 0)
violation_reason: Amount of insurance (Coverage A, whole thousands) missing or non-positive on a premium record

violation_sql: j.hurricane_deductible_pct IS NOT NULL AND j.deductible_type <> '3'
violation_reason: Percentage hurricane deductible must carry deductible type code 3

match_name: Rule 7 — Louisiana Fortify Home Mitigation Credits
violation_sql:
j.mitigation_credit > 0
AND (j.mitigation_code IS NULL OR TRIM(j.mitigation_code) = '')
violation_reason: Fortify Home mitigation credit reported without the mitigation code

violation_sql:
j.record_type = 'L' AND j.paid_amount > 0
AND (j.cause_of_loss IS NULL OR j.accident_date IS NULL)
violation_reason: Paid loss must carry the cause of loss code and the accident date
Closed-without-payment claims must report a paid amount of zero with disposition code C
Loss record missing the catastrophe serial number (0 for non-catastrophe losses)
